QuestInfo.name: [Henesys Ruins] Creator of Dreams
QuestInfo.0: You met #bNeinheart#k in #bpresent Ereve#k and reported your findings from the Gate to the Future thus far.
QuestInfo.1: Neinheart thinks there is a conspiracy related to the Gate to the Future. He asked you to let him know if you discover #banything unusual#k beyond the gate.
QuestInfo.2: According to the latest info obtained by the Alliance, a follower of the Black Mage has the power to create dream worlds. This might be related to the Gate to the Future. Continue investigating the Gate to the Future.
